name: Redstone Glaze Candle
descriptionKo:
Encased in a handcrafted ceramic jar with a volcanic glaze finish, the Redstone candle blends plum nectar, tobacco, and cedarwood to create a rich, leathery scent, accentuated by sweet amber notes over a comforting, earthy depth.
A deep crimson plum ignites against an amber-like hue. This fragrance is an olfactive expression of materiality, evoked through a glaze of deep plum nectar and the woody, leathery essence of dried tobacco leaves and cedarwood
The volcanic glaze is applied with a series of artisanal techniques. As a result, each item is unique
• Material: clay, glaze, wax
featuresKo: A deep crimson plum ignites against an amber-like hue. This fragrance is an olfactive expression of materiality, evoked through a glaze of deep plum nectar and the woody, leathery essence of dried tobacco leaves and cedarwood
The volcanic glaze is applied with a series of artisanal techniques. As a result, each item is unique
Fragrance notes: plum, tobacco leaves, cedarwood essence
Volcanic glazes are high temperature glazes. Artisans have studied and developed them to be able to apply them to the low temperature clays, following two years of research
This item comes with a dedicated exclusive packaging

storySections.bodyKo: Encased in a handcrafted ceramic jar with a volcanic glaze finish, the Redstone candle blends plum nectar, tobacco, and cedarwood to create a rich, leathery scent, accentuated by sweet amber notes over a comforting, earthy depth.

• Place the candle on a flat, heat-resistant surface. • Burn your candles no longer than 4 hours maximum each time. Allow the wax to solidify before relighting. • Trim the wick to a length of 5mm after each use. • Once the candle is finished, remove any remaining wax by gently cleaning it with a non-abrasive cloth and mild soap solution. • Dry thoroughly.
